/provinces/ontario/toronto/.intro: Start with the type of visit you need: washing your dog yourself, a short tidy, or a full haircut. The Toronto options below publish different packages and booking arrangements; choose the correct branch before requesting a time.

businesses.name: FUR BAR
businesses.comparison: Fur Bar separates full haircuts from bath-and-tidy and de-shedding packages.
businesses.confirm: Select the Toronto booking link for King Street West.
facts: The Toronto branch is at 844 King Street West; its published number is 416-366-7729.
The full groom includes bathing, drying, nails, ears and a full haircut. Bath-and-tidy includes light face, feet and sanitary trimming.
Puppy grooming and bath-and-de-shedding are listed separately.

businesses.name: Juju Grooms
businesses.comparison: Juju Grooms describes low-impact grooming and an appointment-day discussion of your dog’s needs.
businesses.confirm: Ask for a coat-specific estimate and allow for the quoted visit length.
facts: The official site lists 1684 Queen Street West and 416-792-1684.
Dog appointments typically take three to five hours; size, coat condition and temperament affect timing.
An emailed photo can help with an estimate, but the site says a quote is not the final price.

businesses.name: Dirty Pawz Self-Serve Dog Wash
businesses.comparison: Dirty Pawz offers self-service washing alongside lite grooming and full grooms.
businesses.confirm: Self-service needs no appointment; reserve staffed grooming separately.
facts: The site lists 804 Queen Street East and 529 Adelaide Street West.
The full-grooming online calendar is for Queen Street; the service page asks Adelaide customers to call.
The full groom includes a bath, drying, brushing, clipping and nail, ear, paw and sanitary care.

/provinces/alberta/calgary/.intro: Compare appointment structure as well as grooming packages. These Calgary businesses publish different time allowances and drop-off arrangements, so a convenient address alone may not determine which visit fits your day.

businesses.name: Sunshine Dog Grooming Inc.
businesses.comparison: Sunshine describes one-to-one attention in a kennel-free setting.
businesses.confirm: Ask about your dog’s coat, handling needs and total appointment time.
facts: The published location is Unit 101B, 14919 Deer Ridge Drive SE, with phone 403-605-8355.
The site describes baths, trims and grooming tailored to individual dogs, and links to online booking.

businesses.name: Muttley Crue Organics
businesses.comparison: Muttley Crue allows four to five hours and includes daycare with grooming.
businesses.confirm: Confirm early drop-off or late collection when booking.
facts: The grooming page lists Unit 112, 620 46 Avenue NE and 403-262-6888.
It describes breed-specific cuts and hand scissoring, with breaks between grooming stages.
The booking instructions ask new clients to create a profile, upload vaccinations, then call to arrange grooming.

businesses.name: Spa 4 Paws
businesses.comparison: Spa 4 Paws asks customers to allow at least three hours for grooming.
businesses.confirm: An online request is followed by email confirmation.
facts: The contact page lists Unit 4, 2650 36 Street SE and 403-457-1225.
The service categories are bathing, grooming and nail trims; the site offers online appointment requests.

/provinces/alberta/edmonton/.intro: Confirm both the service and the Edmonton branch before booking. A bath-and-brush appointment, a styled haircut and a walk-in nail visit have different requirements; retail or daycare hours may not be grooming hours.

businesses.name: Oh My Dog Spa and Grooming
businesses.comparison: Oh My Dog lists bath-and-dry, bath-and-tidy, grooming and hand stripping.
businesses.confirm: Choose the north location on the booking page; confirm walk-in nail hours.
facts: The north address is 216 Mistatim Road NW; the site also lists a separate south location at 5596 Windermere Boulevard.
The published number is 780-655-1797.
The booking page advertises walk-in nail trims and separates north and south appointment options.

businesses.name: The Pampered Puppy
businesses.comparison: The Pampered Puppy publishes a haircut package and offers daycare at its 124 Street branch.
businesses.confirm: Use centralized booking and specify 124 Street, Mayfield or Southside.
facts: The 124 Street branch is at 10303 124 Street NW. The contact page lists 780-732-7277 for calls or texts.
The Pampered Package includes a bath, haircut, nail clipping and ear care.
The website restricts daycare to the 124 Street location, with different grooming days at other branches.

businesses.name: Posh Pooch Hotel and Daycare
businesses.comparison: Posh Pooch offers bathing, brushing, de-shedding and nail trims, including standalone spa visits.
businesses.confirm: For a haircut, ask directly whether your requested styling is available.
facts: The spa page lists 9402 31 Avenue NW and 780-435-3115.
Bath-and-brush packages vary by coat length and size; the site notes that condition, temperament and time can affect the final price.
Spa services can be booked without a daycare or boarding stay.

/provinces/quebec/montreal/.intro: Decide whether you want a salon visit or grooming brought to your home. For Montreal mobile services, confirm your exact address and parking arrangements; for any reservation form, check that the business has confirmed your appointment.

businesses.name: Mobispaw
businesses.comparison: Mobispaw’s Montreal page describes a van that comes to the customer and a full-groom package.
businesses.confirm: Confirm service coverage for your address and the space needed for the van.
facts: The Montreal package lists bathing, brushing, a haircut, ear cleaning and nail trimming.
Its published coverage includes Montreal neighbourhoods and additional surrounding areas; confirm your address before reserving.

businesses.name: SPA Beasts V.I.P.
businesses.comparison: SPA Bêtes VIP publishes dog and cat grooming and a reservation form.
businesses.confirm: Specify pet size, the service requested and your preferred time; confirm the location.
facts: The official site describes grooming for dogs and cats.
The reservation form asks for pet type, dog size, breed, age and preferred date and time.

/provinces/ontario/hamilton/.intro: Check new-client availability before comparing appointment times. The Hamilton sources below show why a salon can be operating normally while its regular schedule is full; contact details and a booking button alone do not establish availability.

businesses.name: Dogs By Daisy
businesses.comparison: Dogs By Daisy describes wider appointment slots for individual attention.
businesses.confirm: Ask for the package inclusions and time allowance for your dog.
facts: The business lists bathing, haircuts, nail trimming and ear cleaning among its services.
Its website says services are by appointment and links to an appointment page.

businesses.name: Somerset Grooming
businesses.comparison: Somerset’s published notice says it is not accepting new clients into its regular schedule.
businesses.confirm: Call about the new-client waitlist or cancellation list; availability may change.
facts: The official site provides 905-385-0168 for booking.
Its 2026 booking notice describes a new-client waitlist and a cancellation list, rather than immediate availability.

/provinces/british-columbia/surrey/.intro: Compare the service package and the right contact channel. Some Surrey businesses separate phone calls from appointment texts, and a store with several branches may have different salon availability at each location.

businesses.name: Furfection Dog Spaw ltd
businesses.comparison: Furfection separates its voice number from its new booking-system text number.
businesses.confirm: Use the published voice number for calls; confirm your service before reserving.
facts: The site lists Unit 123, 6820 188 Street, and 778-710-7297 for voice calls.
It publishes bathing, nail trimming, hand scissoring, hand stripping and de-shedding.
All services are by appointment; reception hours are not a guarantee of grooming availability.

businesses.name: Pet Solutions Supermarket & Grooming
businesses.comparison: Pet Solutions says most grooms take about two to two-and-a-half hours.
businesses.confirm: Confirm the Surrey branch when calling and ask about coat-specific timing.
facts: The Surrey store is listed at 10602 King George Highway, with phone 604-585-3737.
Its grooming page includes nails, pad tidying, bath, brush, drying and styling in the groom.
The business also lists a Delta store, so verify where your appointment will take place.
